rootUrls.description: A list of file paths to parse from

regex.description:
The regex used to parse rows from the file content. Each capture group
in the regex becomes a column in the output DataFrame.

headers.description:
Optional list of column names for the output DataFrame.
The list size must match the number of regex capture groups.
If omitted, columns are named c1, c2, ... cN by default.

includePath.description:
If true, includes a 'path' column with the source file path.
Defaults to false.

maxLinesForLastColumn.description:
The maximum number of subsequent lines to append to the last column of a regex match, for handling multi-line entries.
Default is 1, which means the last column will only contain the line that matched the provided regex.
If set to -1, all lines following the regex matched line, up to the next matched line, will be appended
to the text in the last column

maxVarcharColumnSizeMb.description:
The maximum size in megabytes for varchar columns.
Defaults to 1.0 MB.

onVarcharColumnTooLarge.description:
Behavior when a varchar column exceeds the size limit specified by {@link #maxVarcharColumnSizeMb}.
Defaults to FAIL.
